combo_box.name: audio_output_device
combo_box.tool_tip: Where all of the viewer's sound plays: world sounds and voice. System default follows your system's sound settings. A device picked under Voice Input/Output devices still wins for voice. Media (web pages, video, music played through the media plugins) stays on the system default.

combo_box.name: audio_input_device
combo_box.tool_tip: The microphone the viewer uses (voice). System default follows your system's sound settings. A device picked under Voice Input/Output devices still wins for voice.

combo_box.name: vr_audio_output_device
combo_box.tool_tip: Where world sounds and voice play while you are in VR. Automatic uses the headset's own audio (as the VR runtime reports it, or found by its name). A device picked here that is not connected when VR starts leaves audio on the devices above. Everything goes back to the devices above when VR ends.

combo_box.name: vr_audio_input_device
combo_box.tool_tip: The microphone voice and dictation use while you are in VR. Automatic uses the headset's own microphone. A device picked here that is not connected when VR starts leaves voice on the microphone above.

slider.label: VR headset gain (dB)
slider.name: vr_audio_gain
slider.tool_tip: Extra loudness for world sounds and voice while they play on the VR headset (headset audio is often quieter than desktop speakers). Applies only in VR.
